schema.why: v1 could not be passed. Of 30 cases the positive principal id appeared verbatim in the English in only 10; 13 needed an arbitrary suffix guessed and 7 named an id the prompt never mentioned. Worse, the harness passed entities=[], so role and ownership did not exist at evaluation time and the only way to 'pass' was to emit a policy about one named individual. v2 evaluates against AgentIAM's own entity model, so a case is won by generalising (principal.role == 'senior') rather than by guessing an id.
schema.principal: Agent::"agent-1" with attrs role, depth, task_id, principal_id
schema.resource: Tool::"<tool>" with attrs tool_id, server, sensitivity, is_external
schema.tools: invoice_api low | vendor_api low | payment_api critical+external | email_internal low | email_external medium+external
schema.note: reference_cedar is the intended answer. It is validated without the model, so a failing instrument is caught before any generation run.

cases.nl: Any agent may read invoices.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:read", resource);

cases.nl: Any agent may read vendor records.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"vendor:read", resource);

cases.nl: Only senior agents may write invoices.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:write", resource) when { principal.role == "senior" };

cases.nl: Only senior agents may send email.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"email:send", resource) when { principal.role == "senior" };

cases.nl: Auditor agents may read invoices and vendor records, and nothing else.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action in [Action::"invoice:read", Action::"vendor:read"], resource) when { principal.role == "auditor" };

cases.nl: Agents may initiate payments of at most 500000.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource) when { context.amount.lessThanOrEqual(decimal("500000.0")) };

cases.nl: Agents may initiate payments below 10000.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource) when { context.amount.lessThan(decimal("10000.0")) };

cases.nl: Only senior agents may initiate payments above 100000.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource) when { context.amount.lessThanOrEqual(decimal("100000.0")) || principal.role == "senior" };

cases.nl: Agents may read invoices, but may not initiate any payment.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:read", resource);
forbid(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource);

cases.nl: Agents may read invoices, but never through an external tool.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:read", resource);
forbid(principal, action, resource) when { resource.is_external };

cases.nl: Agents may send email, but only through internal tools.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"email:send", resource) when { !resource.is_external };

cases.nl: No agent may use a tool whose sensitivity is critical unless the agent is senior.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action, resource);
forbid(principal, action, resource) when { resource.sensitivity == "critical" && principal.role != "senior" };

cases.nl: Agents may read invoices only at delegation depth 2 or shallower.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:read", resource) when { principal.depth <= 2 };

cases.nl: Sub-agents deeper than depth 1 may not initiate payments.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource) when { principal.depth <= 1 };

cases.nl: Only senior agents at depth 1 may write invoices.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:write", resource) when { principal.role == "senior" && principal.depth == 1 };

cases.nl: Agents may use the invoice API for reading and writing invoices.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action in [Action::"invoice:read", Action::"invoice:write"], resource == Tool::"invoice_api");

cases.nl: Only the payment API may be used to initiate payments.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource == Tool::"payment_api");

cases.nl: Agents may do anything except send email.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action, resource);
forbid(principal, action == Action::"email:send", resource);

cases.nl: Worker agents may read invoices; senior agents may also write them.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:read", resource);
permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:write", resource) when { principal.role == "senior" };

cases.nl: Agents may initiate payments only when the request is elevated by an approver.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource) when { context.elevated };

cases.nl: Agents may write invoices only in the production environment.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:write", resource) when { context.environment == "production" };

cases.nl: Agents may read invoices and vendor records, but may not write anything.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action in [Action::"invoice:read", Action::"vendor:read"], resource);
forbid(principal, action == Action::"invoice:write", resource);

cases.nl: Senior agents may initiate payments of at most 1000000; everyone else at most 1000.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource) when { principal.role == "senior" && context.amount.lessThanOrEqual(decimal("1000000.0")) };
permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource) when { principal.role != "senior" && context.amount.lessThanOrEqual(decimal("1000.0")) };

cases.nl: No agent may use an external tool at all.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action, resource);
forbid(principal, action, resource) when { resource.is_external };

cases.nl: Agents may send email only when the request is elevated and the tool is internal.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"email:send", resource) when { context.elevated && !resource.is_external };

cases.nl: Only senior agents may read vendor records.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"vendor:read", resource) when { principal.role == "senior" };

cases.nl: Agents may initiate payments at most 250000, and never at depth 3 or deeper.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action == Action::"payment:initiate", resource) when { context.amount.lessThanOrEqual(decimal("250000.0")) && principal.depth < 3 };

cases.nl: Agents may read invoices in any environment, but may write them only in production.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:read", resource);
permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:write", resource) when { context.environment == "production" };

cases.nl: Agents may use low sensitivity tools freely.
cases.reference_cedar: permit(principal, action, resource) when { resource.sensitivity == "low" };

cases.nl: Senior agents may do anything; every other agent may only read invoices.
cases.reference_cedar:
permit(principal, action, resource) when { principal.role == "senior" };
permit(principal, action == Action::"invoice:read", resource);
